jobs.title: Business Analyst/POPM
jobs.description:
**IT BUSINESS ANALYST**

**ENTERPRISE DATA \& ANALYTICS**

**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER**. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

**The Team**


As part of the Global Technology Organization, the aim of Enterprise Data and Analytics (ED\&A) team is to enable Mattel as a data\-driven organization, by:

* Delivering high quality data for self\-service analytics and data science via a modern data infrastructure that supports our business partners and aligns with business strategy.
* Ensuring data quality through governance and data management processes.
* Maximizing the availability of data.
* Providing the infrastructure, tools, and knowledge to add value to data.
* Promoting enterprise\-wide adoption through sustainable education and training programs on our tools and data.

 **The Opportunity**


Mattel is seeking a Business Analyst, based out of our Technology \& Innovation Center in Hyderabad, India, reporting to the IT Director for Enterprise Data and Analytics. The person filling this role will act as an interface between business and technical groups \- eliciting requirements from the business, designing analytics solutions and/or data models from a business user perspective, and working with our development teams to implement them – taking the role of a Product Manager in a SAFe Agile working model. This person will also lead and participate in data governance processes, and as a subject matter expert, will be able to provide training, support and assistance to business users on our data and tools.

 **What Your Impact Will Be:**

* Act as a Product Manager in a SAFe Agile working model on Enterprise Data and Analytics projects, primarily to deliver business\-ready data sets for end users to utilize for reporting and analytics.
* Work collaboratively within IT and across global teams, ensuring timely delivery of projects and enhancements while adhering to budgets.
* Gather and analyze requirements, documenting acceptance criteria for product features and translating business problems into clear, actionable tasks.
* Independently design and deliver analytics and reporting solutions from a business user perspective, coordinating closely with development teams to implement initiatives.
* Partner with business stakeholders to document processes and identify improvement opportunities, actively providing suggestions for enhanced efficiency and effectiveness.
* Create and execute test plans while coordinating testing and implementation efforts with business users to ensure smooth project delivery.
* Participate in data governance initiatives by contributing to the maintenance of business glossaries, data transformation rules, and data categorization practices.
* Identify data quality issues and take ownership of implementing exception reporting to address gaps.
* Maintain and share updated documentation with the user community to ensure proper understanding and adoption of implemented solutions.
* Act as a point of contact and trusted “Face of IT” for business partners, independently addressing challenges and articulating business needs effectively.
* Support the design and successful implementation of analytics or reporting solutions in collaboration with business partners.
* Manage analytical troubleshooting and work with production support teams on resolving issues for project deliverables or production systems.
* Provide training to business users on our data and reporting/visualization tools (ThoughtSpot, Tableau, IBM Cognos Analytics, Google BigQuery, Collibra).
* Actively contribute to adding value to business partners’ organizations by proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.

**What It’s Like to Work Here**


We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower the next generation to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

* **We collaborate:** Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* **We innovate:** At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* **We execute:** We are a performance driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best in class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

 **What We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business or related field. MBA is a plus.
* 2\+ years of experience as a business analyst, data product manager or in a similar position.
* Professional level understanding of general business processes and functions, with capability to analyze and document proposals for data products aligned with organizational goals and reference architecture.
* Demonstrable experience in working with data and databases required – Google Cloud Platform/BigQuery would be a significant advantage.
* Demonstrable experience in reporting/visualization tools required \- ThoughtSpot, Tableau and/or IBM Cognos Analytics would be a significant advantage.
* Knowledge of data governance practices and data management tools,…

jobs.title: Lead Engineer – 2 - Vendor Management Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview:  

The Vendor Management Analyst supports the team with all aspects of the business and technology sourcing needs with strategic Vendors. This role will support Vendor Manager in implementing guidelines and processes for coordinating management of the contract, resource, and performance management, working with Global stakeholders and partnering with Procurement \& Finance to provide insights/reporting for Vendor Portfolio Management.

 **Accountabilities:**

 **1\. Vendor Governance and Relationship Management:**

* Support the team to develop the framework, governance structure, and knowledge repository for SBRs, Top to Tops, QBRs with a concentrated focus on 10 partners in scope for Vendor Strategic Planning (VSP).

* Assist in coordinating governance discussions for Vendors

* Working with Sector \& Global stakeholders and providing insights/reporting for Strategic Partner Portfolio Management.

* Creating and maintaining vendor profiles for strategic \& preferred Vendors by conducting market research.

* Establishing efficient guidelines and proceses to manage PepsiCo’s strategic relationships with partners

* Conduct market research, competitor analysis and support the team in vendor/technology scouting.

* Maintain supporting documentation for VSP, including SBR deck, T2T briefers.

* Provide support to the team (VRMs and innovation team) with global strategic and preferred vendors (AMESA, APAC, Europe, LATAM) – track the issues as applicable

**2\. Vendor Performance Management:**

* Support Track, report and analyze the performance of Strategic Vendors using Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Business Satisfaction Surveys

* Assist in definition, refinement, and consistent reporting of KPIs to PEP senior leadership

* Innovation : Support the team to deliver 3\-4 Horizon 1 programs working with Service Owners

* Innovation : Support VSP program from the data perspective and external research

  



**3\. Vendor Contract Compliance and Sourcing Risk Management:**

* Resolves inquiries from stakeholders related to the contracts
* Assist in managing the Contract Change management process

**4\. Vendor Resource Management:**

* Validation of Vendor consumption data (e.g., resource unit validation, verifying calculations, ensuring volume pricing adjustments are applied, etc.) or Project related SOWs using established process.

* Provide input to Finance to support the development of PepsiCo financial forecasts, financial business cases, and budget plans as required at a sector level

* Analyze the data and generate insights for external labor productivity.

 **5\. Vendor and Sourcing Strategy and Execution**

* Support the development of self\-service dashboards and insights to support vendor strategy

* Support any documentation or data gathering aspects of vendor capability matrices across L1 areas of focus to enable optimized vendor landscape with a concentrated focus on 10 top partners in scope for VSP

* Elevate relationship with key innovation partners, maintaining documentation to support vendor profiles and T2T

 **6\. Reporting (Power BI )**

* Develop and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards and data models.
* Analyze requirements and create data visualizations to meet stakeholder needs.
* Design and implement data governance procedures.

  


Responsibilities:* Ability to interact with key stakeholders and communicate persuasively in a multi\-functional environment
* Ability to organize and prioritize work and meet deadlines through excellent time management and strong organizational and problem\-solving skills
* Highly organized and responsive, with ability to work on tight timelines.
* Stakeholder alignment and management competency
* Technical service delivery and/or IT operations experience is a plus
* Ability to take ownership and drive issues to resolution

  


Qualifications:* 6\+ year college degree or commensurate work experience
* 3 – 5 years experience in Vendor Relationship Management, Governance or Procurement areas with interest or knowledge in environment.
* 3 – 5 years experience Financial Management (preferable)
* 3 – 5 years experience in environment (preferable) and Contract Management
* 3\-5 years’ experience with Power BI and Data Visualization

  



**Tech Skills:**

* Good analytical skills and attention to detail
* Excellent MS Office skills, in particular Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Proficient in English, both verbal and written
* Medium to High level understanding of commercial contracts or contracts
* Knowledge of Vendor Management tools
* **Power BI and data visualization**
* Ability to deliver credible insights through work products and communication
* Capable of managing multiple time sensitive priorities simultaneously
* Detail\-oriented; organized in approach and in documentation
* Ability to work well in a virtual team environment
* Consistently shows urgency, courtesy and patience
* Exceptional communication skills
* Capacity to analyze at deep level and connect data from different sources to drive actionable decisions
* Experience building relationships, negotiating, and influencing key stakeholders, internal and external partners to drive decisions

As a Product Manager in consumer and community banking, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end\-to\-end product life cycle. jobs.title: Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
### **Job Summary:**


We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-oriented Relationship Manager to join our dynamic team. The Relationship Manager will be responsible for building and nurturing strong, long\-lasting relationships with a portfolio of clients, understanding their financial needs, and providing tailored solutions. This role requires a proactive individual with excellent communication skills, a deep understanding of financial products, and a commitment to delivering exceptional client service.


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Develop and maintain strong, trust\-based relationships with an assigned portfolio of clients, acting as their primary point of contact.
* Proactively engage with clients to understand their financial goals, challenges, and evolving needs through regular meetings and communication.
* Identify opportunities to cross\-sell and up\-sell relevant financial products and services, including investments, lending, insurance, and wealth management solutions.
* Provide expert advice and guidance on various financial products, explaining complex information clearly and concisely.
* Conduct comprehensive financial reviews for clients, analyzing their current financial situation and recommending appropriate strategies.
* Achieve individual and team sales targets and key performance indicators (KPIs) related to client acquisition, retention, and revenue generation.
* Resolve client inquiries, concerns, and issues efficiently and effectively, escalating complex matters to appropriate internal departments when necessary.
* Collaborate closely with internal specialists (e.g., product specialists, credit analysts, legal) to ensure seamless client service and integrated solutions.
* Stay abreast of market trends, economic conditions, and competitor offerings to provide informed advice and maintain a competitive edge.
* Ensure all client interactions and transactions comply with regulatory requirements and internal policies and procedures.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date client records and activity logs within the CRM system.
* Prepare and present regular reports on client portfolio performance and sales activities.

**Overview**
 Commercial Engineering \& AI (CEAI) is the frontier organization for Microsoft’s Commercial Business. We bring together AI‑native engineering, modern platforms, and deep commercial insight to reimagine how work gets done \- at scale and with impact. Our mission is to unlock new ways of operating through intelligent systems while creating the conditions for our teams to do the most meaningful work of their careers.
   

  

 Customer Success Engineering (CSE) sits within CEAI and builds the AI\-powered platforms, applications, and agents that transform how Microsoft engages, retains, and grows its customers. We operate as a builder organization — we ship, measure real usage, and ship again — pairing deep domain expertise with AI\-assisted development to move from idea to validated value in days rather than quarters using Microsoft technology stack. If you’re excited to build, experiment, and shape the future of commercial execution with AI at the core, we invite you to apply.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager who is equal parts Product Strategist and hands\-on AI Builder. This is an AI\-native product role: you won’t just define what to build — you’ll use AI to build it. You will set the strategy for the next wave of AI solutions across Microsoft’s Customer Success motion, then rapidly prototype and ship those solutions yourself using AI\-assisted development. This role blends two operating modes. Great candidates are strong in both — and comfortable moving between them daily:
   

  

**Product Strategist**
* Owns the multi\-quarter vision and roadmap for AI\-first applications.
* Frames the problem spaces, defines the bets, and sequences the portfolio.
* Translates business goals into measurable product outcomes.
* Aligns leaders, engineering, and design around a shared strategy


**AI Builder**
* Uses AI to build — prototypes and ships applications, agents, and workflows.
* Turns concepts into working demos in days, not quarters.
* Instruments builds with telemetry and evals for AI quality and impact.
* Raises team throughput by applying AI to the product\-development loop.


 Your work will directly impact multi\-billion\-dollar businesses — fueling revenue growth, sharpening competitive advantage, and optimizing margins. You will also push the latest AI frontiers, including autonomous agentic workflows, deep research and reasoning, and multi\-agent frameworks, while maintaining a relentless focus on high\-quality user experiences — from conversational UX to emerging interaction models across the Microsoft and Copilot ecosystem. Just as importantly, you will use AI to raise the productivity of the entire product organization, establishing the tools, patterns, and evals that let the team ship better products, faster.
   

  

**Requirements**
 This role reflects how product management is evolving in CSE — from requirements author to builder and decision architect. We look for people who consistently demonstrate four shifts:
   

  

* Builder, not just author. Move beyond specifications to build lightweight business models, decision flows, prototypes, and AI\-assisted experiments that stakeholders can evaluate before engineering commits — using AI\-assisted development to check in production\-ready code for enhancements where it accelerates learning. The goal is to shrink the distance between an idea and validated business value.
* Systems thinker. Sees every feature as a node in a larger system rather than a standalone deliverable — thinking end\-to\-end from upstream inputs to downstream impact. Asks "how should the system behave to achieve the outcome?" rather than "what feature should we build?" Uses AI to model systems, expose hidden dependencies, generate edge cases, and evaluate downstream impacts before implementation begins.
* Intelligent orchestrator. Treat AI as a reasoning partner that challenges assumptions, proposes alternatives, and automates routine coordination — synthesizing requirements, summarizing decisions, and surfacing risks — so your time is reinvested in ambiguous problems and strategic calls.
* Decision architect. Shifts from "is the requirement complete?" to "do we have evidence the solution will achieve the outcome?" Defines evals up front and lets data — not opinion — drive the call, generating evidence through business\-rule simulation, scenario modeling, edge\-case generation, and prototype validation. Correctness before code.


**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**
**Set the Strategy**
* Own the vision and roadmap. Define a multi\-quarter product strategy for AI\-first applications, translating business goals into a coherent portfolio of prioritized scenarios and bets.
* Envision the next wave. Lead scenario envisioning and UX \& technical product design for agentic and Copilot\-powered experiences; advise on GTM, adoption, and evolving portfolio strategy.
* Shape long\-term direction. Capture, frame, and drive key product insights and ecosystem signals from the market to shape the future of Microsoft AI platform, apps, and toolset.
* Lead prioritization, backlog management, and cross\-team alignment, focusing teams on the highest\-impact work


**Build with AI**
* Prototype, don’t just spec. Use AI to rapidly build applications, agents, and workflows with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and AI\-assisted (low\-code / “vibe coding”) development.
* Turn concepts into working software. Stand up functional demos and pilots in days, validate them with real users, and iterate quickly toward production.
* Ship production quality. Partner with engineering to build and ship robust, reliable, inclusive experiences — owning quality and adoption end to end.

**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This role is part of a broader enterprise initiative to establish a
 **Data Context Layer (DCL)** 
 — a foundational capability designed to provide consistent, reusable, and scalable context across enterprise data products.
   

  

 The DCL is intended to address challenges related to
 **data fragmentation, lack of shared semantics, and inconsistent interpretation of data across systems and products** 
 . It establishes a unified layer for representing context, relationships, and meaning, enabling downstream products to operate with greater consistency, interoperability, and intelligence.
   

  

 In addition, the DCL plays a critical role in enabling
 **agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise** 
 by providing the structured context and semantic grounding required for intelligent agents to operate reliably. This includes ensuring that agent\-driven workflows and decisions are based on
 **consistent, governed, and interpretable data context** 
 , reducing risks associated with fragmentation, ambiguity, and lack of control.
   

  

 Within this initiative, the Associate Director – Product Manager, Context Serving. will own the
 **product definition, development, and evolution of core context serving capabilities** 
 . These capabilities form the backbone for how context is consumed across multiple products and platforms, and will be central to enabling
 **governed, scalable, and reusable intelligent systems** 
 .
   

  

 The role operates at the intersection of
 **product, architecture, and enterprise platforms** 
 , working closely with Enterprise Architecture, platform teams, and product leadership to build
 **enterprise\-grade context capabilities that support both traditional data products and emerging AI\-driven use cases** 
 .
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a Product Manager to own a single, high\-impact capability within our enterprise data context platform
 **self\-service serving of standardized data context** 
 . This role will focus on defining, building, and scaling one core capability that enables teams to publish, discover, and consume data context consistently across the enterprise.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong product instincts, technical fluency in data/semantic systems, and experience partnering with engineering and architecture teams to deliver a platform capability from definition through production adoption. This role also requires working knowledge of
 **agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering** 
 concepts, particularly as they relate to delivering reliable, reusable context for AI\-enabled applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision, requirements, and roadmap for the assigned capability within the context platform.
* Define how the capability supports standardized, self\-service serving of data context.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, and governance teams to translate standards into implementable product requirements.
* Ensure the capability is intuitive for users and scalable for enterprise adoption.
* Define workflows for
+ publishing context
+ discovering context
+ consuming context through approved interfaces
+ validating and maintaining context quality

* Collaborate with adjacent platform teams to ensure the capability integrates cleanly with broader context, metadata, and governance services.
* Work with stakeholders to prioritize features, resolve tradeoffs, and drive adoption.
* Define success metrics such as usage, reuse, quality, and time\-to\-onboard.
* Support the transition of the capability from development into production, including release readiness, documentation, and operational requirements.
* Help shape how the capability supports agentic AI workflows, including reliable context delivery for prompts, tools, skills, and AI assistants.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of product management experience in technical products, data platforms, or enterprise software.
* Ability to work closely with engineering teams on platform or infrastructure capabilities.
* Familiarity with data context, metadata, ontology, or semantic concepts.
* Working knowledge of agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering concepts.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience defining requirements for self\-service or platform capabilities.

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Quality Assurance (Automation)** **Engineer** to lead quality engineering initiatives across enterprise applications. This role will work closely with Business Analysts, Developers, Product Owners, and Project Managers to ensure delivery of high\-quality software solutions.


This roe will be responsible for ensuring application quality through a combination of manual and automated testing. The role will help establish and expand automated testing capabilities across Corporate Functions technology platforms.

* Define and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases.
* Analyze business and functional requirements and identify automation opportunities.
* Review requirements and provide feedback on testability and quality risks.
* Establish quality metrics and reporting mechanisms.

**Test Automation**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust automation frameworks.
* Create and execute automated test scripts for UI, API, integration, and regression testing.
* Improve automation coverage and optimize execution efficiency.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

**Test Execution \& Defect Management**

* Execute manual and automated test cases.
* Identify, track, and verify software defects using defect management tools.
* Coordinate with development teams for defect resolution and root cause analysis.
* Ensure quality standards are met before production releases.

**Collaboration \& Leadership**

* Mentor junior QA analysts and automation engineers.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, and retrospectives.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Promote shift\-left testing and quality engineering best practices.
* Evaluate emerging testing tools and technologies.

**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineering Lead  

**Project Role Description :** Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.
  

**Must have skills :** Software Architectures  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **12** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Senior Software Architect \& Developer  

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands\-on Senior Software Architect / Senior Developer to design, build, and guide the development of our next\-generation market infrastructure for fund distribution, leveraging cloud\-native, microservice, and blockchain/DLT technologies.  

  

This hybrid role combines deep architectural leadership with pragmatic, high\-quality engineering. As a senior technical authority, you will define architectural patterns, mentor engineers, participate in code design and delivery, and ensure our software platform is scalable, secure, and future\-proof.  

  

The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and a strong coder, comfortable making architecture decisions while contributing directly to implementation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement across squads.  

  

Your responsibilities include  

  

Architecture \& Technical Leadership  

Define, evolve, and maintain the technical architecture of a complex cloud\-native, microservice\-based platform.  

Drive key architectural decisions, ensuring alignment with product vision, scalability needs, and regulatory requirements.  

Produce architectural diagrams, reference designs, integration patterns, and API/interface definitions.  

Partner closely with the Product Architect to ensure technical design matches functional domain models.  

  

Hands\-On Design \& Development  

Contribute directly to development of core services, components, and libraries in the platform.  

Lead complex feature implementations, ensuring code quality, testability, and performance.  

Review code, mentor developers, and drive best practices across teams.  

Provide expert guidance on system design, data flows, resilience strategies, and performance optimization.  

  

Cloud\-Native Engineering \& DevOps Collaboration  

Support the adoption of cloud\-native best practices such as containerization, service mesh, IaC, and observability.  

Collaborate with DevOps to optimize CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and runtime configurations.  

Ensure that infrastructure and application design supports high availability, automated scaling, and robust monitoring.  

  

Blockchain / DLT Integration  

Design and support integration points between on\-chain and off\-chain services (smart contracts, event listeners, tokenization flows).  

Collaborate with blockchain engineers and Product Architects to ensure consistent, auditable, and performant DLT interactions.  

Support long\-term evolution of blockchain usage and its alignment with business needs.  

  

Security, Compliance \& Quality  

Champion secure\-by\-design principles, encryption patterns, access control models, and auditability.  

Conduct threat modelling, identify potential vulnerabilities, and guide remediation strategies.  

Ensure development practices meet the reliability, resilience, and regulatory expectations of financial market infrastructure.  

  

Cross\-Team Collaboration \& Mentoring  

Act as a senior technical partner to Product Owners, Business Analysts, and QA engineers.  

Mentor junior and mid\-level developers, promoting strong engineering culture and continuous learning.  

Assist in troubleshooting complex production issues and conducting root\-cause analyses.  

Support alignment across squads when implementing cross\-cutting features or shared components.  

  

Key skills  

  

Strong proficiency in one or more backend languages (e.g., Java, Kotlin, Scala, Go, Rust, Node.js, or similar).  

Expertise in cloud\-native architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and distributed systems.  

Solid experience with microservices, event\-driven architectures, APIs (REST/GraphQL), and messaging systems.  

Good understanding of blockchain/DLT concepts, smart contracts, and integration patterns (highly preferred).  

Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modeling, and performance optimization.  

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and observability tooling.  

Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to break down complex technical challenges.  

Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across teams.  

  

Required experience  

7–12\+ years of software engineering experience, including several years in senior or lead roles.  

Proven experience designing and delivering complex distributed systems in cloud\-native environments.  

Hands\-on experience implementing microservices at scale, ideally in fintech or financial services.  

Prior exposure to blockchain/DLT systems is a strong advantage.  

Demonstrated ability to combine architectural thinking with hands\-on coding and technical design.  

Experience mentoring engineers and influencing engineering practices across multiple teams.  

Experience working in Agile, multi\-squad environments with strong delivery cadence.


  

15 years full time education

An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. jobs.description:
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.**About Finance Reporting \& Data Analytics CoE**
-------------------------------------------------

Driving efficiency and standardization across our renowned consumer brands that enhance everyday lives—from nourishing meals to trusted household essentials—is the pivotal force of the Finance Planning \& Reporting Center of Excellence (CoE). Fuelled by a culture of collaboration and innovation, the CoE is integral to our organization, championing financial excellence and strategic insight across our global landscape. We are a dynamic, agile team, relentlessly focused on enhancing our financial processes, harnessing advanced analytics, and delivering unparalleled value to every facet of our business.We transcend traditional finance roles; we are a strategic partner where diverse talents converge to tackle intricate financial challenges, foster sustainable growth, and empower our mission to create a healthier, more sustainable world for all. By ensuring a clear line of sight between strategic goals and day\-to\-day financial activities, we enable efficient performance management and better business results through the collaboration of our people, processes, and systems.Our CoE transforms finance from a traditional back\-office function into a strategic powerhouse that drives business value, as talented individuals come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better business.

**About the role**
------------------



As a Senior Analyst in the Finance CoE, you will report into a Finance Manager and be part of a team of analysts supporting a portfolio of markets. In this role, you will play a key part in executing financial planning and reporting activities across these markets. You will support the creation of standardized reports, development of initial forecasts/budgets, and analysis of financial performance to enable data\-driven decision\-making. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to multiple markets while contributing to the centralization and improvement of Reckitt’s FP\&A processes. If you are passionate about finance, data analysis, and continuous improvement, this role will allow you to grow and make a real impact on our global business.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------


* Produce and consolidate financial reports for monthly and quarterly results, ensuring key performance metrics (sales, profitability, costs, etc.) are accurately reported and delivered on time to global and regional stakeholders.
* Conduct variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) and clearly explain drivers behind the numbers, highlighting trends and insights that inform business decisions.
* Support the planning and forecasting cycles, including annual budgets and periodic forecasts: coordinate data collection from different markets, validate submissions, and align assumptions with global guidelines to create a cohesive financial outlook.
* Manage and enhance financial dashboards and reports (e.g. in Power BI or similar tools) to provide users with intuitive, up\-to\-date views of financial performance. Ensure that dashboards capture the right KPIs and that data is consistent across all reporting outputs.
* Participate in finance transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline and improve existing FP\&A processes. You’ll contribute to standardizing report templates, automating manual tasks, and sharing best practices that elevate our CoE’s efficiency and impact.
* Collaborate closely with market finance teams and other CoE members to ensure data integrity and one\-source\-of\-truth in our financial systems. You will act as a liaison, helping local teams understand CoE processes and troubleshooting data or reporting issues to maintain accuracy.
* Assist with ad\-hoc analysis and projects as needed, such as deep\-dives into specific expenses or trends, scenario modeling for strategic projects, or financial deck preparation for senior leadership meetings. Your ability to turn data into actionable insights will be key in these projects.
* Adapt and excel in a dynamic environment – our CoE is continually evolving. You’ll be expected to handle last\-minute changes or requests, work under tight deadlines especially during key reporting periods, and maintain a high standard of quality. In doing so, you’ll demonstrate agility, teamwork, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------


* 4 \- 5 years of experience in finance, analytics, or a related field, ideally within the CPG sector.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with reporting tools (e.g., Power BI).
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.
**The skills for success**
--------------------------


* Financial Analysis \& Reporting
* Strategic Planning
* Business Partnering
* Process Improvement
* Data Visualization Skills
* Project Management
* Team Leadership
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Change Management
* Continuous Improvement Mindset
**What we offer**
-----------------



With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. jobs.title: Senior Data Product Analyst – Data Distribution & Data Share Capabilities
jobs.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**


LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Data Distribution and Platform capabilities, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm.


This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives.


The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support product and platform decisions related to data distribution via feeds, APIs, and shared platforms.


The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

**Responsibilities:**


Data Distribution \& Platform Enablement

* Partner with Product Managers and Platform Capability Owners to support data distribution strategy, including feeds and shared data services.
* Help define and refine data products that serve multiple downstream consumers (internal teams, platforms, partners).
* Analyze data usage patterns, dependencies, and downstream impacts to inform platform and roadmap decisions.
* Support decisions around standardization vs. specialization in data distribution models.

Product Discovery \& Capability Support

* Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.
* Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data distribution initiatives.
* Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).

Advanced Data Analysis \& Problem Solving

* Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.
* Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.
* Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.
* Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.

Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)

* Support Data Product Owners by helping define:
* Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions
* Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls
* Usage expectations and downstream dependencies

jobs.title: Data Strategy & Acquisition Analyst
jobs.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  

That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  

As aData Strategy\& Acquisition Analyst based inHyderabad within our Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE), you will build deep expertise in the U.S. healthcare data landscape. You will partner with cross\-functional teams and U.S. stakeholders to evaluate, acquire, and manage data sources, directly shaping how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

* Dataset Management: Support the evaluation, acquisition, and ongoing management of a broad range of U.S. healthcare datasets, including payer, market access, claims, sales, and competitive intelligence.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate closely with U.S. stakeholders to understand business needs, clarify use cases, and translate complex business questions into clear data requirements, evaluation criteria, and actionable next steps.
* Vendor Evaluation: Evaluate new and existing datasets and vendors (such as IQVIA, Komodo Health, MMIT, and DRG Fingertip) based on business relevance, methodology, quality, limitations, and fit\-for\-purpose application.
* External Partnerships: Partner with external data vendors to understand source methodologies, resolve data\-related queries, and ensure timely access to high\-quality datasets.
* Data Profiling\& Risk Assessment: Apply structured thinking to perform data profiling, data comparison, and validation. Assess potential gaps or risks, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive pushback to ensure alignment with business objectives.
* Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation, including dataset summaries, vendor comparisons, and standard operating procedures, to support decision\-making around data investments.


Who You Are
  
  

* Education: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* Experience: You have 2–4 years of relevant experience in pharma, healthcare analytics, life sciences consulting, market research, or commercial analytics.
* Industry Knowledge: You bring a strong foundation in biology, life sciences, and the pharmaceutical industry, possessing a deep understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, the drug development process, and the U.S. commercial/market access landscape.
* Analytical\& Strategic Thinking: You possess strong analytical reasoning and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail. This enables you to engage stakeholders consultatively, ask strategic questions, and synthesize complex information into clear summaries, actionable recommendations, and “so what?” insights.
* Communication\& Organization: You are an effective communicator with strong organizational and documentation skills. You can manage multiple priorities and are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively across time zones with U.S.\-based teams and external vendors.
* Data Platforms\& Datasets Expertise: You have exposure to external healthcare data platforms and vendors (e.g., MMIT, DRG Fingertip, IQVIA, Komodo Health, Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group, NCCN). You are highly familiar with datasets spanning payer intelligence, sales, claims, real\-world data (RWD), field intelligence, market access, and competitive/market intelligence.
* Technical Skills: You are familiar with (or willing to learn) SQL for basic data extraction, validation, and investigation. Additionally, you have exposure to data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, or similar platforms, along with a basic understanding of data quality concepts.


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon is seeking a Senior Tax Analyst to join its direct tax reporting team in Hyderabad, India. This position will be responsible for tax reporting and tax compliance of Amazon’s legal entities located in the EMEA region.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Working within the EMEA Foreign Reporting \& Compliance team, the Senior Tax Analyst will be required to:  

* Prepare / Review foreign income tax returns and other foreign tax filings and supporting work papers
* Prepare / Review foreign income tax provisions under IFRS and/or Local GAAP
* Prepare / Review estimated tax payments
* Support income tax accounting and reporting under US GAAP for SEC reporting purposes
* Support international tax controversy teams on tax audits
* Work with other stakeholders, including Accounting and Transfer Pricing teams
* Assist with process improvement and automation implementation throughout the foreign tax reporting and compliance process, including use of Artificial Intelligence
* Support regular reporting of key metrics to Management
* Participate in special projects, as necessary
* Support international tax compliance and reporting aspects of mergers and acquisitions (due diligence and integration)

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will support the EMEA International Tax Senior Manager group on the tax reporting (direct tax returns \& tax accounting) as well as on international aspects of the Amazon's worldwide income tax provision. This position will also support the US and international tax controversy teams on audits and the international planning tax team on the compliance and reporting aspects of projects (including M\&A and integration) and will work closely together with the EMEA Accounting teams.
  

  

About the team  

The Amazon tax department is a fast\-paced, team\-focused, dynamic environment. The mission of the EMEA Foreign Reporting \& Compliance team is to comply with foreign local tax reporting requirements and manage the worldwide, tax\-related filings of Amazon’s foreign entities.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* 4\+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* Experience working in a large public accounting firm or multi\-national corporate tax department
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* CPA
* Experience a direct tax role in a multinational and/or professional organization
* Experience working in fast paced environments, and managing workload even during times of stress, or escalated activity
* Experience with tax compliance of one or more countries in EMEA region is a benefit

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s supporting our songwriters, ensuring we provide the right royalty data to global partners, or helping our creative teams use the latest AI tools to discover new talent, technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Product Managers help turn vision into reality.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to partner with a local in\-person engineering team in Bengaluru focused on music distribution. Distribution is the vital link between music creation and a fan’s headphones, ensuring our music reaches platforms like Spotify and YouTube globally while protecting the complex rights that ensure our artists get paid. You will be a "user\-first" thinker who is responsible for a portfolio of features and products, navigating the high\-stakes world of global rights, supply chain automation, and high\-scale digital delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Continuous Discovery: Build deep empathy for our labels, operations teams, and global partners by maintaining a constant dialogue with them. Uncover their underlying pain points, ensuring that every solution we build truly solves their problems and makes their daily workflows more seamless.
* Strategy \& Roadmap: Define and communicate the long\-term vision and roadmap for your products, ensuring they align with WMG’s broader tech strategy.
* Product Trio Collaboration: Work in a "Product Trio" alongside Engineering and Design to solve complex problems, resolving trade\-offs and tackling risks.
* Execution \& Ownership: Serve as the primary author of PRDs and the "executor\-in\-chief" for your projects, driving development from ideation through technical delivery.
* Launch \& Impact: Develop comprehensive go\-to\-market strategies, including product positioning, internal messaging, and launch plans. You don't just "ship" code; you ensure the organization is ready to adopt it to achieve maximum impact.
* Analytical Optimization: Continuously monitor product performance metrics, user feedback, and market trends. Use this data to make informed prioritization decisions, identify areas for improvement, and manage technical debt to optimize the product over its entire lifecycle.


**Who You Are**
* Experienced: You have at least 5 years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to the music business or other digital media.
* Technical \& Business Savvy: You can discuss system architecture with engineers and business constraints with executives, mitigating Value, Usability, Feasibility, and Business Viability risks upfront.
* A Master Storyteller: You own the "Why" and can easily adjust your communication style for different audiences, from developers to more senior stakeholders.
* Biased to Action: You have a proven ability to unstick a team, make difficult prioritization decisions, and navigate the ambiguity of a global business.
* Humble Leader: You have strong opinions, held weakly; you are quick to share credit with your team and accept responsibility when things don’t go as planned.
* Mission\-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid.

**PRODUCT MANAGER — HOTEL \| FINKRAFT.AI**
 Location: Bengaluru, HSR \| Full\-time \| Level: L4 \| Reports to: CPO / BU Head
   

  

**About Finkraft.ai**
 Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250\+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr\+ in GST claims and are scaling from $1\.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months.
   

  

 The Hotel vertical is our primary growth unlock for the next 18 months. This PM owns it.
   

  

**THE PROBLEM YOU ARE SOLVING**
 A corporate employee books a hotel through a TMC or GDS. The booking passes through a PMS like Opera Cloud. The invoice is generated by the hotel, sometimes routed through a Concur integration or a bank lodge card program. By the time the finance team tries to claim GST on that invoice, the corporate GSTIN is missing, the folio is incomplete, the tax breakdown is wrong, or the invoice never arrived.
   

  

 This happens at scale across every enterprise client Finkraft serves. Your job is to understand every node in that chain — hotel, PMS, GDS, OTA, TMC, Concur, bank, payment player — and build the product that fixes it.
   

  

**What You Will Own In 90 Days**
* Full ecosystem map completed: every player in the hotel invoicing and GST chain documented — where data breaks, who owns the fix, and what Finkraft's integration surface is at each node.
* Field engagement calendar live: structured visit schedule across TMCs, hotel chains, corporates, and software companies — minimum 15 discovery meetings completed, findings structured into roadmap inputs.
* One PRD shipped to engineering: based on field findings and existing client pain, a product spec written, reviewed, and in active development.


**Key Responsibilities**
 Product Strategy and Roadmap
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end product strategy for the Hotel vertical: what gets built, in what sequence, and why
* Define the roadmap based on enterprise client pain, ecosystem partner signals, and competitive landscape — not internal assumptions
* Present roadmap to leadership, Sales, and enterprise clients at QBRs; defend prioritisation decisions with data and customer evidence
* Track roadmap delivery against committed timelines; own the gap between what was promised and what shipped


 Field Ecosystem Engagement
   

  

* Conduct structured field meetings across the full hotel ecosystem: TMCs (BCD, CWT, FCM, SOTC), GDS providers (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport), OTAs (MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, Expedia), hotel chains and revenue management teams, PMS vendors (Opera Cloud, IDS, Hotelogix), corporate travel managers, expense platform teams (Concur, Happay, Zoho Expense), banks (for lodge card and virtual card programs), and payment platforms (Razorpay, HDFC SmartPay, Mastercard CEP)
* Extract structured product intelligence from every field meeting: integration documentation, data flow maps, GSTIN handling gaps, invoice format standards, and API availability
* Convert field findings into product inputs within 5 business days of every meeting — not raw notes, structured inputs


 Ecosystem Integration Ownership
   

  

* Map data flow across the full chain: hotel PMS â GDS/OTA/TMC â Concur/expense tool â bank/payment â Finkraft â GST claim
* Identify where corporate GSTIN, folio data, and invoice tax breakdowns break at each handoff
* Define integration specifications for priority ecosystem partners; own the partner relationship through integration go\-live
* Maintain a live integration roadmap: what's in production, what's in development, what's blocked and why


 PRD and Engineering Partnership
   

  

* Write clear, complete PRDs for every feature in development: problem statement, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics
* Partner with engineering through the full build cycle — not just handoff and review
* Attend standups, unblock decisions in real time, and accept or reject releases based on defined criteria
* Maintain a product backlog that engineering can execute against without PM involvement in every sprint decision


 Sales, BA, and CS Collaboration
   

  

* Feed qualified product intelligence to Sales: what integrations exist, what gaps remain, and what client use cases are unlocked by each roadmap item
* Work with Senior BAs on field observations — BA finds the problem, PM defines the fix
* Support enterprise client conversations on product capability, integration timelines, and roadmap commitments — own what you say in the room
* Partner with CS on rollout plans for new features: training, documentation, and client communication owned by PM, not CS


 Market and Regulatory Intelligence
   

  

* Track GST regulatory changes relevant to hotel invoicing: e\-invoicing thresholds, folio compliance requirements, GSTIN transmission mandates
* Monitor hotel\-tech landscape: new PMS entrants, GDS API changes, OTA invoicing policy shifts, Concur integration updates
* Bring competitive signals into roadmap prioritisation — what are enterprise clients being offered by alternatives?


**Requirements**
**REQUIREMENTS**
 Must Have
   

  

* 4–6 years in product management in travel, hospitality, fintech, or enterprise B2B SaaS
* Has conducted field discovery meetings with external ecosystem partners — not just internal user interviews
* Working knowledge of corporate travel ecosystems: TMCs, GDS platforms, OTAs, PMS providers, and how they connect
* Has shipped a B2B product that integrates with at least two external systems — understands what "integration complexity" actually means in production
* Has written PRDs that engineering shipped from without PM hand\-holding in every stand\-up
* Comfort with field\-heavy, travel\-intensive work across India

jobs.description:
**Product Manager** 




 Bengaluru, India \| Hybrid WFO \| Full\-time 
 



  





***About us***




 RockED is a performance development platform built for the automotive industry. We partner with over 10,000 dealerships across the U.S., as well as major OEMs who use our platform to run and manage their own training programmes at scale. Our mobile\-first app helps dealerships onboard new hires faster, develop stronger teams, and reduce turnover by delivering bite\-sized training to sales reps, service advisors, and technicians right on their phones. 
 



 The platform spans learning and performance management. On the learning side, it includes an AI Coach for personalised practice, gamified learning, and role\-based certifications. On the performance management side, the platform surfaces real\-world performance data for dealership staff, such as service advisors, and recommends targeted training based on that data to drive measurable improvement on the floor. We are headquartered in Florida with our R\&D team in India, backed by investors with strong roots in automotive and EdTech. 
 



 We partner with 10000\+ dealerships, empower 60,000\+ learners, complete 15000\+ certifications, and have crossed 11 million lesson completions
 



  





**Check out our website https://www.rocked.us/** 




  





***Your Impact***




  





 This is one of the highest\-leverage seats on the product team. You'll sit close to Product leadership — not translating a roadmap someone else wrote, but owning real business problems end to end across learner experience, engagement, content delivery, and admin tools.
 



 You decide what "good" looks like for these areas, you build the case for what gets built next, and you're accountable for what happens after it ships.
 



 We're not looking for someone to run a backlog. We're looking for someone who can walk into a messy, half\-defined problem — service advisors aren't finishing training, managers ignore the admin dashboard — and turn it into a shipped answer without a lot of hand\-holding.
 



  





**What you will actually own?** 




  




* **The roadmap for learner experience, engagement, content delivery, and admin tools** 
 — not a list of features you're handed, but a point of view on what matters and why, one you can defend to leadership and to engineering.
* **Direct lines to the people who use this every day** 
 — dealership managers, sales reps, service advisors, technicians. You talk to them regularly, not once a quarter, because their world is the real spec.
* **PRDs and user stories, tight enough that engineers just run with them** 
 — no epic back\-and\-forth, no "wait, what did you mean by this." Clarity is the job.
* **A real seat at the design table** 
 — you should have opinions on the UX, and you should be comfortable telling design something feels off before it ships, not after.
* **The connective tissue with our US team** 
 — launches, timelines, stakeholder updates. Some overlap with US hours comes with this territory.
* **The metrics that prove, or disprove, your bets** 
 — you define what "working" means for your areas, and use it to decide what earns a place on the roadmap next.
* **Growth and engagement plays** 
 — using tools like MoEngage and HubSpot to get the right nudge to the right person at the right moment.



  





**How do we expect you to work?** 




  




* **Build, don't maintain.** 
 Most of what you'll own doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing the first version of it
* **Speak fluent engineering.** 
 You don't need to write code, but you need to understand trade\-offs well enough that engineers don't have to over\-explain themselves to you, and well enough that they trust your calls
* **Use AI like it's already the default.** 
 We expect AI in the actual workflow — AI\-assisted discovery, AI for first\-draft docs and prioritisation, AI for turning raw customer feedback into patterns, AI for moving faster on the parts of the job that used to eat a whole afternoon
* **Own outcomes, not tasks.** 
 Nobody here grades you on how many tickets moved to "done." You're graded on whether the thing you shipped actually changed a number that mattered



  





**Who tends to thrive here?** 




  




* You like problems that are still messy — nobody's handing you a clean spec
* You think in systems, not features — you can see how a change to onboarding ripples into retention three months later
* You're obsessed with what the customer actually needs, not what's easiest to build
* You use data and judgment together — you can read a SQL query and still trust your gut when the data's incomplete
* You're curious enough to ask "why" more than once, and secure enough to challenge an assumption respectfully, even when it's someone senior's
* You know the difference between a feature that's interesting and one that moves the company
* You ship the 20% of a feature that carries 80% of the value — on purpose, not because you ran out of time
* EdTech or B2B SaaS background helps, but we care far more about how you think than the logo on your old business card.



  





**Why this, why now?** 




  





 We're growing over 100% year on year, backed by investors who've already built and exited multiple companies in this space. Our team spans the US and India, so you'll get exposure most Product Owners at this stage don't — to leadership, to investors, and to the real mechanics of scaling a platform used by frontline workers at 10,000\+ dealerships.
 



 We also run periodic in\-person workcations, because some of the best product thinking happens away from a desk.
 



**If owning a real slice of a fast\-scaling platform — with the freedom to build it your way and the accountability that comes with it — sounds like exactly the kind of company you want to build with, we want to talk to you.**

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

**About The Role**
 HackerRank's goal is straightforward: to give companies a dependable way to evaluate whether a candidate can do the job. The previous model, which relied on test cases and code correctness, is becoming less reliable as candidates use AI assistants and produce work that requires deeper scrutiny.
   

  

 The Evaluation team is rebuilding the underlying scoring system. This involves defining the new evaluation rubrics, determining how our models apply them consistently across thousands of candidates, working with enterprise clients to define good performance, and ensuring our methodology is fair and defensible.
   

  

 Evaluation's trustworthiness is fundamental to HackerRank's business and its products. We are looking to hire a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to own this crucial charter.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the evaluation product roadmap: what gets built, in what order, and why, with a clear point of view on what the product needs to become over the next 12 to 18 months.
* Define what "good evaluation" means in product terms: the rubrics, scoring dimensions, bias safeguards, and consistency checks that enterprise customers will stake hiring decisions on.
* Work directly with ML engineers and AI researchers to translate methodology into shipped product. You are the connective tissue between research clarity and engineering execution.
* Talk to enterprise customers regularly. Understand how Goldman Sachs defines a strong candidate differently from how a startup does, and make sure the product can serve both.
* Build the feedback loops that let the evaluation system improve: how we capture when customers disagree with a score, what signals we surface to the ML team, and how we close the loop.
* Define and own the metrics that tell us whether evaluation quality is actually improving, not just whether we shipped something.


**Who You Are**
* You have 5 or more years of product experience, with meaningful time in a B2B or enterprise context where your work had to be defensible to sophisticated customers.
* You think rigorously about if the measures actually map to the outcomes. A PM who cannot tell the difference between a good metric and a vanity metric will not survive this role.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity in the problem definition. The answer to "what does good evaluation look like" does not exist yet. You need to want to find it, not wait for someone to hand it to you.
* You can hold your own in a technical conversation with ML engineers without needing to code. You understand enough about model behavior, evaluation pipelines, and data feedback loops to ask sharp questions.
* You communicate with precision. Crisp PRDs, sharp debate in design reviews, clear framing to customers and leadership. You do not hide behind vague language when the problem is hard.


**Even better if you have**
* Prior experience in assessment, ed\-tech, talent tech, or any domain where you had to build products around subjective or qualitative evaluation.
* Exposure to fairness, bias, or compliance considerations in a product context.
* Experience building or working closely with ML\-powered scoring or ranking systems.
* Track record of defining new product categories rather than iterating on established ones.


**You will thrive if you**
* Believe the evaluation problem is one of the most interesting unsolved problems in enterprise software right now.
* You want to own a roadmap that is genuinely consequential, not increment on features that already exist.
* Are the kind of PM who would rather have a sharp conversation about what we should not build than ship something that does not hold up. You are not scared of technical depth. You lean into it.


**Want to learn more about HackerRank?** 
 Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here.
   

  

 HackerRank is a proud equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal opportunity to everyone for employment based on individual performance and qualification. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Linkedin \| X \| Blog \| Instagram \| Life@HackerRank
   

  

**Notice To Prospective HackerRank Job Applicants**
* Our Recruiters use @hackerrank.com email addresses.
* We never ask for payment or credit check information to apply, interview, or work here.

* **Orchestrate and manage technical execution**:
	+ Lead the project team through the Offer Creation Process \- defining, scoping and executing the deliverables and collaborative activities throughout the phases of the offer lifecycle.
	+ Build and maintain the detailed project schedule with work breakdown structures and defined milestones, managing dependencies and aligning roadmaps. Coordinate across multiple technical disciplines (HW, FW, SW, Mechanical, and Compliance) and cross\-functional groups to define scope and deliverables for each feature and/or requirements.

jobs.description:
**Some careers have more impact than others**.


If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Associate Director, MRM Validation Lead****.**

**Model Risk Management**

* Model Risk Management (MRM) at HSBC is structured as a global function, headed up by the Chief Model Risk Officer (CMRO). The MRM function reports directly to the Group Chief Risk and Compliance Officer (GCRCO) ensuring its independence from the model developing and owning areas of the firm. MRM are the second line of defence (2LoD) for Model Risk and the CMRO is the global Model Risk Steward for the group and is also accountable for the global operation of the MRM function. MRM teams are based in each region, to ensure local subject matter expertise and to guide, review, and challenge. MRM activity is managed on a global basis as many models are used in multiple locations. This enables MRM to operate consistently and efficiently globally, and to take account of additional local regulatory requirements.
* Model Risk Governance \- Setting the firm's model risk policies and standards, ensuring that model risk is managed within the approved tolerance levels, providing second line assurance on the implementation of policy, and monitoring regulatory developments impacting model risk.
* Model Risk Stewardship \- Facilitating responsible development, understanding and use of models and analytics, as well as providing subject matter expertise, advice, guidance, and effective challenge across all entities, regions, global businesses, and functions.
* Independent Model Validation\- Independently reviewing and (re)validating models, providing an objective, unbiased and critical opinion on the suitability and soundness of models for their intended use and the accuracy, relevance and completeness of outputs used to inform business decisions.
* Independent Model Validation is a specialist quantitative role within the Model Risk Management team responsible for carrying out independent validations of HSBC’s model landscape, in order to identify and communicate model limitations and issues. Independent Model Validation provides independent challenge of a model’s underlying theoretical assumptions and limitations, its practical implementation, its live application and business usage, providing stakeholders (including model users, senior management, audit and regulators) with assurance that models and tools developed, maintained and used within HSBC Group are fit for their intended purposes and are compliant with applicable internal and supervisory expectations. They will also review remediation plans and activities, undertake portfolio level reviews across model types and challenge the model owners on the appropriate application of relevant policy of models.
* Model types include but are not limited to Credit Risk models (Retail and Wholesale)\- IRB/IFRS9 models, Stress Testing and Scenario Analysis models, Economic Capital models, Financial Vulnerability models, Pricing models, Traded Risk models, Insurance Risk models and models covering non\-financial areas e.g., transaction monitoring, customer selection and human resources. This includes the traditional model types as well as modern approaches such as machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) techniques.
* This job description is for **Market Risk model validation.**

**In this role, you will:**

* Undertake measures to independently execute end\-to\-end model validations as dictated by the Global Model Risk Policy including the assessment of model inputs, calculations, reporting outputs, conceptual soundness of the underlying theory and the suitability of the use for its intended purpose, relevance and completeness of data, qualitative information and judgements, documentation, and implementation of the model.
* Design, develop, and execute testing frameworks, tailored to specific model complexities to identify risks and limitations. Develop and implement advanced validation methodologies and tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the validation process.
* Responsible for ensuring the execution of model validation projects within their functional stream, ensuring timely delivery and quality of work. Contribute to the continuous improvement of validation processes and methodologies, suggesting enhancements and opportunities to streamline processes.
* Lead discussions and negotiate with model developers and business owners regarding validation outcomes including identified issues and limitations, remediation actions, and when required defending validation conclusions effectively.
* Guide the interaction with Group Internal Audit on model related audits, MSIIs and audit issues.
* Proactively participate in strategic initiatives for MRM, being a champion of changes and proactively making suggestions for improvements. Collaborate closely with senior managers in Global Businesses and Functions in order to plan, prioritise and deliver model risk management activities that are aligned with business strategic goals and priorities, whilst ensuring strong second line independence and oversight is maintained.
* Guide the Global Model Risk Steward by ensuring that potential model risk issues, impacts to risk appetite, internal and external audit findings and regulatory issues are managed appropriately and escalated in a timely manner as required.Guide the preparation and delivery of model risk management opinions and papers for inclusion in first and second line senior governance forums, including Country/Regional\…
