jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Interested in working on software used by millions of customers every day? Intrigued by the opportunity to contribute to one of the largest open source projects in the world? The Amazon Silk browser team is looking for a strong software development engineer to join our ranks. We are actively building new features using Alexa, machine learning, and other AWS technologies that re\-shape the way customers browse, discover, and consume web content.  

  

We operate like a startup in a big company \- our engineers work closely with product management and user experience designers to build best\-in\-class services and apps. Our engineers are owners who identify, define, and build solutions that delight millions of customers every day. We are building our organization based on smart people, diversity of perspective and experience, and looking for individuals with a “can\-do” attitude who love to tackle hard problems.  

  

What you'll do:  

* Be an integral part of an exceptionally talented team. Working in a fast paced environment with rapid feature delivery to our customers.
* Brainstorm, build and ship new and exciting features that revolutionize the way people browse the web. You have the opportunity to own a features/experiences from inception to delivery.

  

  

  

This team is a good fit for you if:  

* You are sensitive to customer needs and interested in having a firsthand impact on Amazon’s global customer base
* You truly care about the business results of what you build, not just the elegance of the technology
* You like to solve interesting technology problems
* You enjoy collaborating in a diverse team environment
* You are a passionate learner and motivated to take on new challenges.
* You want to have fun; surround yourself with a highly talented pool of engineers that like to solve complex problems, but also enjoy work life balance.

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Design and deliver complex features for Silk browser and WebView across multimodal and TV devices, driving end\-to\-end ownership from architecture to launch.  

Lead Chromium upleveling and platform migrations, ensuring compatibility and performance across Fire OS and Vega OS platforms.  

Own build system improvements and release infrastructure to improve developer productivity and release velocity for the team.  

Drive operational excellence — including security patch releases, crash rate reduction, and production health monitoring across device families.  

Mentor and grow junior engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, design reviews, and knowledge sharing to raise the overall bar of the team.  

  

A day in the life  

As a Senior SDE in the Silk Browser team, you will dive deep into Chromium internals to solve complex rendering and performance challenges across Fire TV and multimodal devices, collaborate with product, design, and platform teams to understand customer needs and unblock cross\-functional dependencies, and architect scalable solutions that work across multiple device families and OS versions. You'll spend time reviewing code from teammates, driving technical decisions that balance long\-term code health with near\-term delivery, and shipping features that reach millions of users. You'll have the autonomy to identify problems, propose solutions, and see your work deployed to real customers in a fast\-paced environment that values both rapid iteration and thoughtful engineering.  

  

About the team  

Silk is Amazon's Chromium\-based web browser built for Fire TV and multimodal devices, optimized for the unique constraints of embedded environments to deliver fast, reliable web experiences on television screens and Echo Show devices. Our team owns feature development, performance optimization, and seamless integration with Amazon's device ecosystem, working closely with product managers, and partner teams to build solutions that delight millions of customers. We foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives strengthen our work, invest in each other's growth through mentorship, and believe that balancing professional achievement with personal fulfillment leads to our best engineering.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 8\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 8\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with AI/ML technologies
* Experience with Chromium Browser technology

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Product

 Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, and over 330 other financial services firms to acquire more customers, increase productivity, and deliver end\-to\-end digital experiences. Our software enables our customers to process an average of more than $5 billion in loans per day, making it possible for consumers to reach their financial goals faster and lead better lives. Come do work that matters.
   

  

***Note: This role's initial assignment is serving as the dedicated product owner for a contracted enterprise client build. This will allow the Team Member to learn the product deeply. Scope of that assignment (partial vs. full\-time) is subject to the final Statement of Work.***
****ROLE OVERVIEW****
 Our fastest\-growing home lending product line delivers streamlined digital origination, taking borrowers from application to a qualified, rate\-locked loan in a single digital flow. Deployments range from out\-of\-the\-box to highly customized builds for major banks and credit unions.
   

  

 Every lender runs origination a little differently, and our platform is built to flex to that. We need a Product Architect to step in and advise clients on what's standard, what's configurable, what's custom, and what we won't build, and to turn that guidance into a repeatable discovery process the whole go\-to\-market team can run. This is a forward\-deployed role — you work where the client is, embedded in their process, backed by our engineering and product teams. What you learn in daily client conversations should shape how we package and price the product as our product lines converge onto a single platform.
   

  

**INITIAL ASSIGNMENT: DEDICATED PRODUCT OWNER, ENTERPRISE CLIENT BUILD**
 We are contracting with a major enterprise client for a highly customized build on this product line, and the contract calls for a dedicated product owner. The first assignment for this role is owning that build: gathering and iterating requirements directly with the client, running the backlog with our globally distributed engineering team, and working day to day with the product team.
   

  

 Owning a complex build end\-to\-end is the fastest way to build deep product knowledge — the configuration model, the integration points, where custom work gets expensive — and that knowledge is exactly what the advisory side of this role requires.
   

  

**MISSION**
 Own the technical product relationship with clients on this product line, from first pre\-sales conversation through post\-implementation. * Globally distributed engineering teams

**PROFILE**

* Experience in a client\-facing technical product role such as solutions architecture, technical product management, or implementation consulting
* Mortgage or fintech background strongly preferred; home equity and refinance domain knowledge is a significant advantage
* Self\-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity; this is a strategic individual contributor role that helps define where we're going, not just operate inside today's setup
* Writes requirements engineering can build from without rework
* Comfortable working across global time zones and traveling to client sites as programs require (travel required)


****Compensation:****
* Base Salary Range: $118,000 – $139,000 (This applies to full time hires. Final offer determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to function, level, geographic location, job related knowledge, skills, and experience.)
* Bonus (if applicable): Eligibility is contingent upon both company performance against established goals and achievement of individual performance objectives.
* Equity : Meaningful Restricted Stock Units in public company stock (NYSE: BLND) so you share in Blend’s long\-term growth and success.

jobs.title: OTC Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
**OTC Functional Analyst**
--------------------------


At Johnson Controls, you will help support the systems and processes that enable customers to move from order to cash with accuracy, speed, and confidence. You will work with cross\-functional teams to improve business performance, strengthen operational reliability, and support the day\-to\-day flow of Oracle Fusion OTC processes.

**Role Overview**
-----------------


As an OTC Functional Analyst, you will support and improve Order\-to\-Cash processes across areas such as order management, invoicing, receipts, customer master data, and month\-end activities. This role is well suited for a professional with 4\-6 years of experience who enjoys solving business problems, working closely with stakeholders, and turning functional requirements into effective system support and process improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Support Oracle Fusion Order\-to\-Cash processes and contribute to stable, efficient business operations.
* Analyze functional requirements and help translate them into practical system solutions and process enhancements.
* Work with business and technical teams to support order management, invoicing, customer receipts, and related OTC activities.
* Assist with issue resolution, root cause analysis, and post\-go\-live support for business\-critical processes.
* Support month\-end close activities for OTC\-related subledger processes, including reconciliation and documentation support.
* Partner with stakeholders to improve process reliability, data quality, and end\-user experience.
* Contribute to testing, validation, and change support for system updates and process changes.
* Document functional flows, business rules, and support activities clearly and consistently.

**How You Will Do It**
----------------------

* You will stay close to the business process, listen carefully to user needs, and remove friction where it affects customers or operations.
* You will own your work with accountability, accuracy, safety\-minded thinking, and integrity in every step.
* You will use a continuous\-improvement mindset, asking questions, challenging gaps, and helping the team solve problems early.
* You will collaborate openly across business and technology teams, building trust and aligning different perspectives toward one outcome.
* You will support structured issue handling, clear documentation, and disciplined follow\-through from analysis through resolution.
* You will contribute to reliable delivery by working methodically through testing, validation, and operational support activities.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
* 4\-6 years of experience in an OTC functional analyst, business analyst, or similar role.
* Strong understanding of Order\-to\-Cash processes and their impact across the business.
* Experience supporting Oracle Fusion OTC processes, including order management, invoicing, receipts, or related finance activities.
* Ability to analyze business requirements, identify process gaps, and support functional solutions.
* Experience working with customer master data and month\-end close activities.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work across business and technical teams.
* Solid problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to documentation and follow\-up.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Hands\-on exposure to Oracle Fusion Financials AR or Oracle Fusion Order Management.
* Experience with invoice processing, receipt handling, or AR subledger support.
* Familiarity with DevOps or Agile ways of working.
* Experience supporting testing cycles, change requests, or post\-go\-live operational support.

**Why Join Us**
---------------


You will be part of a team that values practical problem\-solving, customer impact, and continuous improvement. At Johnson Controls, your ideas and collaboration can help strengthen the processes that keep business moving and customers supported.


If you are ready to bring your OTC expertise to a role where your work can make a real difference, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:
**SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST — DATA \& CLIENT INTELLIGENCE \| FINKRAFT.AI**
 Location: Bengaluru, HSR \| Full\-time \| Level: L4 \| Reports to: BU Head
   

  

**About Finkraft.ai**
 Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250\+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr\+ in GST claims and are scaling from $1\.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months.
   

  

**THE OPERATING PHILOSOPHY OF THIS ROLE**
 AI\-first is not a preference here. It is the baseline. Every analysis, every BRD, every QBR deck, every RCA, and every insight you produce starts with AI augmentation. If you are doing something manually that an AI agent could do faster and better, that is a process failure, not a workstyle choice.
   

  

 This role exists because Finkraft's enterprise clients generate more data, more edge cases, and more expansion signals than any team can process without AI. You are the person who builds the system that processes it.
   

  

**What You Will Own In 90 Days**
* AI\-augmented analysis pipeline live: at least 3 recurring workflows (QBR prep, RCA, client health scoring) running through AI tools — output quality higher, turnaround time lower than manual baseline.
* Team operating cadence set: weekly 1:1s and team standups running for both data BAs and field BAs, with structured output templates and quality bar defined.
* Customisation pipeline tracked: live dashboard showing open customisation requests, delivery status, SLA compliance, and revenue attribution — reviewed weekly with BU Head.


**Key Responsibilities**
 AI\-First Analysis and Insight Generation
   

  

* Default to AI augmentation for every analytical task: data pulls, pattern identification, RCA structuring, QBR narrative drafting, and BRD first drafts
* Build and maintain AI\-powered workflows using ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or equivalent — document every workflow so the team can replicate it, not just you
* Use AI agents to surface new insights from existing client data: anomaly detection, ITC trend analysis, reconciliation failure pattern identification, and upsell signal mining
* Measure AI leverage monthly: what percentage of team output is AI\-augmented vs. manual — target moves up every quarter, not sideways


 Team Leadership — Data BAs and Field BAs
   

  

* Manage and develop the data BA team (Ranjith's team): structured 1:1s, performance reviews, technical upskilling in SQL, dashboard tools, and AI workflows
* Manage and develop the field BA team: output quality reviews, client observation structuring, and ensuring field findings translate into actionable product inputs within 5 business days
* Set a clear quality bar for every output type — QBR deck, RCA document, BRD, dashboard — and hold the team to it without doing the work yourself
* Run continuous recruitment for the BA bench: own the JD, screen applications, design the interview loop, and manage the onboarding ramp for every new BA hire


 Automation BRDs
   

  

* Author automation BRDs for engineering: reconciliation logic, validation rules, data transformation workflows, and exception handling — specific enough that engineering can build without a PM translation layer
* Identify automation opportunities proactively — anywhere the team is doing something manually more than twice a week, evaluate whether it should be a BRD
* Maintain a live automation backlog: prioritised, with business justification, effort estimates from engineering, and expected impact on client outcomes
* Own automation delivery from BRD to UAT: you wrote it, you verify it works


 Dashboard Ownership
   

  

* Build and maintain dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent: client health scores, issue resolution tracking, SLA compliance, customisation pipeline, and QBR trend data
* Dashboards are not maintenance tasks — they are decision tools. Every dashboard you build must answer a specific question for a specific audience
* Automate dashboard refresh where possible; reduce manual data preparation to zero on recurring dashboards
* Present dashboard insights at weekly internal reviews and monthly BU Head reviews — proactive, not reactive


 Enterprise Client Management and Push Back
   

  

* Run QBRs for the BU's enterprise accounts: own the data pack, the trend narrative, and the action items — not just the slides
* Manage enterprise client escalations that reach the Senior BA layer: investigate, respond within SLA, and close the loop in writing
* Push back on client requests that fall outside scope, roadmap, or delivery capacity — clearly, with evidence, without damaging the relationship
* Protect delivery timelines against scope creep: every new client request gets triaged, estimated, and formally accepted or declined — no informal commitments


 Client Upselling Through Documentation
   

  

* Build and maintain a upsell documentation library: ROI reports by client segment, value realisation summaries, customisation case studies, and expansion proposal templates
* Produce value reports for top\-25 accounts quarterly: what Finkraft has delivered, in numbers, against what was promised
* Identify expansion signals in client data and QBR conversations; document them with specificity and hand off to Sales with context — not just a name and a note
* Track upsell pipeline contribution from the BA layer: how many qualified opportunities identified, how many converted, what revenue attributed


 Customisation Pipeline Ownership
   

  

* Own the full customisation pipeline: intake, scoping, prioritisation, delivery tracking, and client communication
* Set quarterly customisation targets with the BU Head: number of customisations delivered, average delivery time, SLA compliance rate, and revenue attributed
